adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U show a sustained ~10 mm N, ~3 mm E, ~3 mm U offset starting near day 500 and returning near day 503 (P1). The interior (days 501–502) is flat in residuals after subtracting this offset (Hypothesis P1), confirming a genuine temporary platform. P2 (single day) and P3 (extending to 554) are inconsistent: P3’s long tail lacks return and overlaps later motion; residuals remain offset beyond 503 unless corrected by P1. P4 (544–547) shows only minor ~0.1–0.2 mm offsets with no sustained shift or return; residuals unchanged. P5 (555) is a sharp isolated spike, not a platform. Only P1 satisfies the definition: sustained shift + opposing return across same axes, with smooth physical motion preserved outside.
